newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-MINISTER SAYS SOCIETE GENERALE EYES BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-MINISTER SAYS SOCIETE GENERALE EYES BRANCH.

text.p: Lithuanian European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Friday after a visit to Paris that French bank Societe Generale had told her it was interested in opening a branch office in Lithuania.
Andrikiene said that Societe Generale officials will come to Lithuania in April and is currently carrying out a study of the country.
"If this bank meets all the requirements established for foreign banks, I will do everything possible so that they have the possibility to open their branch," she added.
Andrikiene said she was told by the Lithuanian embassy in Paris that Banque Nationale de Paris also wants to move to Lithuania this year to open a branch office.
